title: Publish v2 docs to github pages
body:
* `$ yarn dev` -> now runs dev app & docs
* `$ yarn docs:publish` -> build for production & publish docs to gh-pages
* `$ yarn docs:build:dev` -> build locally docs (useful for debugging purpose & used by netlify)

Docs are now built in the `/docs` root folder for any env (no more `/docs` and `/docs-preview`)
